medianGrossRent.source: Median gross rent, ACS 2019-2023 5-year estimates, U.S. Census Bureau QuickFacts: Chapel Hill town, North Carolina

meanCommuteMin.source: Mean travel time to work (minutes), ACS 2019-2023 5-year estimates, U.S. Census Bureau QuickFacts: Chapel Hill town, North Carolina

medianHomeValue.source: Median value of owner-occupied housing units, ACS 2019-2023 5-year estimates, U.S. Census Bureau QuickFacts: Chapel Hill town, North Carolina

population.source: 2020 Decennial Census, Chapel Hill town, North Carolina

housingUnits.source: U.S. Census Bureau, 2020 Census Redistricting Data (P.L. 94-171), Table H1 "Occupancy Status", Chapel Hill town, NC: 22,118 occupied and 1,595 vacant. https://data.census.gov/table/DECENNIALPL2020.H1?g=160XX00US3711800

treeCoverPct.source: USFS / MRLC NLCD Tree Canopy Cover, CONUS v2021-4, 30 m. https://www.mrlc.gov/geoserver/mrlc_download/wcs
treeCoverPct.note: Our calculation: mean canopy of the pixels inside the map area (bbox in meridian-city/fetch_osm.py). The Town publishes no official canopy figure. 30 m data reads low in urban areas; EPA EnviroAtlas 1 m land cover (2010) gives 50.3% over the same area.

mapAreaAcres.source: Derived: the 2.8 km square the map covers (bbox in meridian-city/fetch_osm.py)
